ns2:section.sectionText: This course traces the gradual integration of various regions of the world into an interconnected system. It follows a chronological narrative from early modern times to the present. The course highlights a number of different themes, including mobility and cultural encounter; the exchange of commodities, cultural beliefs, and knowledge; empire-building and colonization; the rise of the nation-state; and the various ways in which the environment has powerfully impacted human affairs.
ns2:section.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Hist & Phil, and Cultural Studies - Non-West course.
